text query: why query embedding is needed for embedding-based retrieval in this teaching route

ranked candidate output.text: In this teaching route, understanding embedding-based retrieval requires understanding a query embedding.

A query embedding represents the question as a vector for comparison with stored vectors representing retrieval units. Understanding that representation explains how the question can be matched to candidate retrieval units.
